description: Traffic Flow Dataset for China\u2019s Congested Highways & Expressways is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Hongrui Kou, Yuxin Zhang. "The Traffic Flow Dataset for China\u2019s Congested Highways & Expressways (TF4CHE) is derived from AD4CHE (Aerial Dataset for China's Congested Highways & Expressways). AD4CHE collects data using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating at an altitude of 100 meters and employs advanced calibration techniques to achieve a positioning accuracy of approximately 5 cm. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
